# ChartAnnotationLabelPosition

`Flare.Components.ChartAnnotationLabelPosition`

Where an annotation's label sits relative to the annotation itself.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Auto` | `0` | Chosen from the annotation kind: outside-end for lines, above for points and segments. |
| `Start` | `1` | At the annotation's start (leading edge / first point). |
| `End` | `2` | At the annotation's end (trailing edge / last point). |
